name: Kou Shamo
source:
Born in the autumn of 1950, he is currently 49 years old (as of 1999). He's from Beijing but has been living in Japan for a long time. 

After the bubble economy burst and land prices fell his business gradually contracted.

Currently, he works as a private investigator.
